description: This is the main program code for a .NET application that executes a Python script ('hello_world.py') from a specified or discovered repository root directory. It handles command-line arguments to override the Python executable and script paths, searches for the script or .git directory to determine the repository root, and runs the script using a subprocess while capturing output and errors.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Static class containing the entry point for the .NET application that manages executing the Python script.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: The main entry point that parses arguments, locates the script, and manages process execution.

methods.name: TryRunPython
methods.description: Attempts to run a Python executable with a specified script, capturing output and returning success status and exit code.

methods.name: Quote
methods.description: Quotes a file path if it contains spaces for proper command line argument formatting.

methods.name: FindRepoRoot
methods.description: Searches upward from a starting directory to find either the 'hello_world.py' script or a '.git' directory to determine the repository root.
